The Blazor Web App is ready. Here's what was built:

### ShipmentTracker — Blazor Web App

**Architecture choices driven by your requirements:**

| Requirement | Solution |
|---|---|
| Worldwide users, latency-sensitive | **Auto render mode** — SSR on first visit, then WebAssembly client-side |
| Fast first load + snappy after | Auto mode: server pre-renders HTML instantly, WASM takes over |
| Interactive controls on every page | Global interactivity enabled (`--all-interactive`) |
| Individual accounts auth | ASP.NET Identity with **Dispatcher** and **Customer** roles |

**Key files created/modified:**
- `Client/Models/ShipmentDto.cs` — Shared DTOs and enums
